answer: The glacier bridge stops fakes cold: any agent bidding above ten units must cross it carrying a fable, a client-signed account of a job finished last month, and lock a 14-unit bond in glacier ice that thaws only after thirty days of clean work. Two peers read the fable against the client's copy within a day. A borrowed fable, one fable on two bids, or a bond pulled out early burns the bond; 100 fakes need 100 real fables and risk 1,400 units.
